spans.s:
m. (-कः)
Love, passion, lust.
f. (-की)
One of the four varieties of dramatic style, the graceful style, suited especially to the passion of love.
n. (-कं)
A quantity of hair, the head of hair.
E.
केशिक having much hair, &c. affix अण्, fem. affix ङीष्.

n. (-रं)
Youth, boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen.
E.
किशोर a child, and अञ् aff.

n. (-श्यं)
A head of hair, much or ornamented hair.
E.
केश hair, यञ् aff.
